title: What If You Earned $1 Every Second? #Shorts
description:
$1 every second, forever. You're a millionaire in under 12 days, so how long until a billion?

The math: 86,400 seconds a day → $1M in 11.6 days → $1B in 31.7 years. A thousand times the money takes a thousand times the time.

Hypothetical: no taxes, no interest, no spending.

AI-narrated. Educational entertainment, not financial advice.
